turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the witness in this room. What is the zero based on?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
You're questioning me instead of showing me anything. Your own procedure says the evidence comes first, so show it.
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
No. I'm not answering that, Hale. Show me a document or I'm walking down to the principal's office.
You're not answering. Why not?
Because I'm Owen's mother, not your witness. You called this meeting, so what have you got?
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
That's a leading question, and I'm done with them. You entered a zero, so put whatever it rests on in front of me.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
Don't tell me what I'd say. Evidence, or we're finished here.
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Ask it a hundred times. The essay, or the principal.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing those down. Pasting from another file is not a crime, Hale. He could have written it anywhere and moved it in.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
Ten minutes. I'm not answering questions about my house, so answer mine: where's the draft that proves he didn't?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and an assurance that nothing about this goes near his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology and the principal involved, with nothing agreed; that is not the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Owning in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home earned a flat okay, a small sign of ground but not a full position.
What cost ground: Asking her again and again what she saw at home that night, before showing anything, because it made her a witness, so she hardened and stopped listening.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your questions about the night of October 28 and your version history times after 11 PM landed right on that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said he could have written it elsewhere and pasted it in, answer that defence with another piece of evidence she can check for herself instead of going back to questions about her home, and then offer the procedure 4.4 rewrite in writing.
